name: Templates
intro: Templates is a library of ready-made image and video templates. Pick one, add your media, and generate, so you get a polished look without writing a long prompt.

features.template-categories-standard: The standard templates are grouped into categories like Social Media, Style Transfer, Entertainment and Commercial. Use the filter chips to jump to the look or format you want.
features.industry-niche-templates: Industry templates are video templates made for local businesses, such as restaurants, salons, gyms and real estate. They're ready-made storytelling for service brands.
features.template-studio-model-and-media-sources: Inside the Template Studio, the model picker shows the route it will take. For video templates, Media Sources lets you add a reference image or a source video.
features.ai-enhancer: The AI Enhancer toggle is on by default. It expands a short description into a richer prompt in the background, and you can switch it off for a rawer prompt.
features.advanced-controls: The Advanced button opens extra fields like niche, audience, subject, setting, visual style and call to action. Use them to steer the story and tone.
features.output-tabs: The right panel has four tabs: Enhanced Prompt, Scene Beats, Voiceover and Negative Prompt. They let you see and tweak exactly what the AI will receive.

outro: That's Templates. Find a style that fits, add your own media, and let the template do the heavy lifting.
